cinematic_dialogue:2:1520910001:.text: Huh? How did I get here?

cinematic_dialogue:2:1520910004:.text: It feels like I had a dream...

say:5:1520911001:0.text: Oh, indeed... your wounds are gone!
say:5:1520911001:0.source_cn: 噢，果然……你们身上的伤果然都好了！

say:6:1520911002:0.text: Don't just stand there! Quickly, thank the great Wild Moon!
say:6:1520911002:0.source_cn: 别愣着，快感谢伟大的雅库伯尔之月！
say:6:1520911002:0.male: Don't just stand there! Quickly, thank the great Wild Moon!
say:6:1520911002:0.female: Don't just stand there! Quickly, thank the great Wild Moon!

say:9:1520911004:0.source_cn: 这是神迹！真正的神迹啊！

say:11:1520911005:0.text: The blessing ceremony hasn't even begun, yet I've witnessed divinity! I can die content!
say:11:1520911005:0.source_cn: 赐福仪式还没有正式举办，我居然就亲眼见证了神迹！简直死...

choice_prompt:12:1520911005.text: The blessing ceremony hasn't even begun, yet I've witnessed divinity! I can die content!
choice_prompt:12:1520911005.source_cn: 赐福仪式还没有正式举办，我居然就亲眼见证了神迹！简直死而无憾了！

say:13:1520911006:0.text: Ah, forgive me... I'll speak no more of it.
say:13:1520911006:0.source_cn: 噢，噢……我明白，绝不会再提了。
say:13:1520911006:0.male: Ah, forgive me... I'll speak no more of it.
say:13:1520911006:0.female: Ah, forgive me... I'll speak no more of it.

say:15:1520911007:0.source_cn: 那个战士……你是叫绒耳，对吧？

say:16:1520911008:0.text: You just said you've been helping others clean wounds. When did you learn that?
say:16:1520911008:0.source_cn: 你刚才说你一直在帮其他人清理伤口，你是什么时候学会的？

say:17:1520911009:0.text: I often get injured while hunting. I learned by watching you treat my wounds a few times.
say:17:1520911009:0.source_cn: ……我经常在捕猎时受伤。看你们为我治疗过几次，就学会了。

say:18:1520911010:0.text: Hmm... good. That makes you valuable.
say:18:1520911010:0.source_cn: 嗯……很好。这能让你变得更有用一点。

choice_prompt:19:1520911010.text: Hmm... good. That makes you valuable.
choice_prompt:19:1520911010.source_cn: 嗯……很好。这能让你变得更有用一点。

say:20:1520911011:0.source_cn: 是，我绝对不会辜负狩猎神大人的嘱托。

say:21:1520911012:0.text: You all, come with me. I'll find more suitable tasks for you.
say:21:1520911012:0.source_cn: 你们几个都跟我来。我会给你们找到更合适的差事。

say:27:1520911015:0.text: When their wounds are too severe, they may not heal, and it wastes medicine.
say:27:1520911015:0.source_cn: 受的伤太重，不一定能治好，还会浪费药草。
say:27:1520911015:0.male: When their wounds are too severe, they may not heal, and it wastes medicine.
say:27:1520911015:0.female: When their wounds are too severe, they may not heal, and it wastes medicine.

say:28:1520911016:0.text: Those who survive might not be able to fight anymore. It's very humiliating.
say:28:1520911016:0.source_cn: 活下来的人，也有可能无法战斗。那很屈辱。
say:28:1520911016:0.male: Those who survive might not be able to fight anymore. It's very humiliating.
say:28:1520911016:0.female: Those who survive might not be able to fight anymore. It's very humiliating.

say:29:1520911017:0.text: Better to return their souls to the Wild Moon, to bless the Wildborn.
say:29:1520911017:0.source_cn: 与其那样活着，永远受苦，不如将生命敬献给您，成为您神力...
say:29:1520911017:0.male: Better to return their souls to the Wild Moon, to bless the Wildborn.
say:29:1520911017:0.female: Better to return their souls to the Wild Moon, to bless the Wildborn.

say:30:1520911018:0.source_cn: 这样，才是一个神圣完满的<style=highligh...

choice_prompt:31:1520911018.source_cn: 这样，才是一个神圣完满的<style=highlight>轮回</style>。

say:33:1520911022:0.text: You don't want them to die, just as you don't want me to die.
say:33:1520911022:0.source_cn: 您不希望他们死，就像不希望加拉死。
say:33:1520911022:0.male: You don't want them to die, just as you don't want me to die.
say:33:1520911022:0.female: You don't want them to die, just as you don't want me to die.

choice_prompt:34:1520911022.text: You don't want them to die, just as you don't want me to die.
choice_prompt:34:1520911022.source_cn: 您不希望他们死，就像不希望加拉死。
choice_prompt:34:1520911022.male: You don't want them to die, just as you don't want me to die.
choice_prompt:34:1520911022.female: You don't want them to die, just as you don't want me to die.

say:35:1520911023:0.text: Very well. I'll inform Kordan and Modra.
say:35:1520911023:0.source_cn: 好，加拉会向戈丹和蒙多传达您的意志。
say:35:1520911023:0.male: Very well. I'll inform Kordan and Modra.
say:35:1520911023:0.female: Very well. I'll inform Kordan and Modra.

say:36:1520911024:0.text: <style="highlight">When the blessing ceremony is held</style>, they will announce this news to the Wildborn.
say:36:1520911024:0.male: <style="highlight">When the blessing ceremony is held</style>, they will announce this news to the Wildborn.
say:36:1520911024:0.female: <style="highlight">When the blessing ceremony is held</style>, they will announce this news to the Wildborn.

choice_prompt:37:1520911024.text: <style="highlight">When the blessing ceremony is held</style>, they will announce this news to the Wildborn.
choice_prompt:37:1520911024.source_cn: <style=highlight>赐福仪式举办时</style>，他们会向雅库伯尔宣布这个消息。
choice_prompt:37:1520911024.male: <style="highlight">When the blessing ceremony is held</style>, they will announce this news to the Wildborn.
choice_prompt:37:1520911024.female: <style="highlight">When the blessing ceremony is held</style>, they will announce this news to the Wildborn.

choice:37:0:1.text: Bring the wounded to witness it.
choice:37:0:1.source_cn: 记得让受伤的人都来见证
choice:37:0:1.male: Bring the wounded to witness it.
choice:37:0:1.female: Bring the wounded to witness it.

choice:34:1:2.text: Life is sacred. It must be preserved.
choice:34:1:2.male: Life is sacred. It must be preserved.
choice:34:1:2.female: Life is sacred. It must be preserved.

choice:31:0:1.text: This is like "survival of the fittest"...
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 弱肉强食不是动物的生存法则吗？
choice:31:0:1.male: This is like "survival of the fittest"...
choice:31:0:1.female: This is like "survival of the fittest"...

say:40:1520911019:0.text: You are the Herdmaster, the Wild Moon. The Wildborn must follow the laws of the herd.
say:40:1520911019:0.source_cn: 您是兽群之主，雅库伯尔之月。雅库伯尔也要遵从兽群的法则。
say:40:1520911019:0.male: You are the Herdmaster, the Wild Moon. The Wildborn must follow the laws of the herd.
say:40:1520911019:0.female: You are the Herdmaster, the Wild Moon. The Wildborn must follow the laws of the herd.

choice:31:1:2.text: Your view of life and death is quite unique...
choice:31:1:2.source_cn: 你们的生死观太独特了……
choice:31:1:2.male: Your view of life and death is quite unique...
choice:31:1:2.female: Your view of life and death is quite unique...

say:41:1520911020:0.text: Modra claimed the Hunting God cherishes the cycle.
say:41:1520911020:0.source_cn: 蒙多说，狩猎神大人喜欢轮回的象征。
say:41:1520911020:0.male: Modra claimed the Hunting God cherishes the cycle.
say:41:1520911020:0.female: Modra claimed the Hunting Goddess cherishes the cycle.

choice_prompt:42:1520911020.text: Modra claimed the Hunting God cherishes the cycle.
choice_prompt:42:1520911020.source_cn: 蒙多说，狩猎神大人喜欢轮回的象征。
choice_prompt:42:1520911020.male: Modra claimed the Hunting God cherishes the cycle.
choice_prompt:42:1520911020.female: Modra claimed the Hunting Goddess cherishes the cycle.

choice:31:2:3.text: Where's the sacredness in this? It's cruel.
choice:31:2:3.male: Where's the sacredness in this? It's cruel.
choice:31:2:3.female: Where's the sacredness in this? It's cruel.

choice:25:0:1.text: Is it common to abandon others like that?
choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 抛弃重伤的人，这种事经常发生吗？
choice:25:0:1.male: Is it common to abandon others like that?
choice:25:0:1.female: Is it common to abandon others like that?

choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 替他们安排工作的事就交给你了

choice:12:1:2.text: None shall die in my presense!
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 我现在对“死”这个字很敏感
choice:12:1:2.male: None shall die in my presense!
choice:12:1:2.female: None shall die in my presense!

narration:43:15010208:0.text: You heal the injured Wildborn warriors with magic. Awestruck, they rise and kneel before you in gratitude.
narration:43:15010208:0.source_cn: 你施展法术治愈了受伤的雅库伯尔战士。他们大为震惊，纷纷...
narration:43:15010208:0.male: You heal the injured Wildborn warriors with magic. Awestruck, they rise and kneel before you in gratitude.
narration:43:15010208:0.female: You heal the injured Wildborn warriors with magic. Awestruck, they rise and kneel before you in gratitude.
